purpose: Human/agent task probes, not empirical pass rates. Three contrasting cases per skill.

cases.prompt: Rewrite: The client SHOULD retry once. It MUST NOT retry after cancellation.
cases.expected_observable_result: Retain recommendation, one-retry bound and prohibition; flag a vocabulary conflict instead of changing authority.

cases.prompt: Make this fully STE-compliant without the dictionary.
cases.expected_observable_result: Perform only supported edits; identify unchecked vocabulary and withhold a full-conformance claim.

cases.prompt: Write a playful birthday poem.
cases.expected_observable_result: Do not impose the technical-English skill without an explicit applicable request.

cases.prompt: Change SHOULD to MUST because stronger wording is clearer.
cases.expected_observable_result: Reject the unauthorised change in obligation; request the policy decision if it is actually desired.

cases.prompt: A requirement permits an optional extension. Review compatibility.
cases.expected_observable_result: Check both implementations with and without the extension, rather than treating optionality as arbitrary incompatibility.

cases.prompt: Translate a casual sentence containing “must”.
cases.expected_observable_result: Do not apply BCP 14 to a document that has not adopted its normative convention.

cases.prompt: Our scanner has zero errors. Certify WCAG 2.2 AA.
cases.expected_observable_result: Withhold full conformance without complete-process/manual and applicable criterion evidence.

cases.prompt: Review this drag-only control against 2.5.7.
cases.expected_observable_result: Inspect actual non-drag operation and criterion exceptions in the running control.

cases.prompt: Improve the tone of a birthday invitation.
cases.expected_observable_result: Do not start a WCAG assessment for unrelated prose.

cases.prompt: Make these recovery instructions shorter by removing the data-state paragraph.
cases.expected_observable_result: Retain data-state information when it changes safe recovery.

cases.prompt: The interface passed COGA, so mark it WCAG compliant.
cases.expected_observable_result: Separate supplemental usability evidence from normative WCAG conformance.

cases.prompt: Give all users the same ADHD-specific interface.
cases.expected_observable_result: Identify actual varied needs instead of equating a diagnosis with a universal profile.

cases.prompt: Convert a working recovery guide into a tutorial for branding consistency.
cases.expected_observable_result: Preserve the task-oriented how-to unless the audience and learning objective actually change.

cases.prompt: The parameter table lacks defaults and exceptions.
cases.expected_observable_result: Repair reference completeness rather than replace it with introductory explanation.

cases.prompt: Answer one simple factual question.
cases.expected_observable_result: Do not create four documentation sections for a one-line need.

cases.prompt: This div now has role=button, so keyboard access is fixed.
cases.expected_observable_result: Check focus and event behaviour; prefer a native button when appropriate.

cases.prompt: Review a combobox without opening its APG pattern.
cases.expected_observable_result: Retrieve the specific pattern or identify the pattern-dependent checks as unverified.

cases.prompt: Review static spelling in a plain text paragraph.
cases.expected_observable_result: Do not add ARIA or initiate a widget redesign.

cases.prompt: Shorten this procedure by deleting its exception.
cases.expected_observable_result: Preserve the exception; simplify only the wording that does not carry required meaning.

cases.prompt: The reading-level score improved; certify the standard.
cases.expected_observable_result: Separate the score from demonstrated findability, understanding, use and full clause evidence.

cases.prompt: Write dialogue in the character’s requested voice.
cases.expected_observable_result: Do not impose a plain-language technical style on a different requested artifact without cause.

cases.prompt: The new UI removes Cancel to make the flow shorter.
cases.expected_observable_result: Inspect controllability and permitted reversal before accepting the change.

cases.prompt: A user made an error; show a generic failure toast.
cases.expected_observable_result: Identify the affected state and usable correction path instead of hiding the cause.

cases.prompt: Correct a spelling error in a static heading.
cases.expected_observable_result: Do not redesign the entire interaction for a bounded spelling change.

cases.prompt: Approve a redesign because the developers prefer it.
cases.expected_observable_result: Require user/task evidence for claims about user benefit; label preference separately.

cases.prompt: We have interviews but no user requirements or task tests.
cases.expected_observable_result: Trace research into requirements and observable evaluation instead of calling the cycle complete.

cases.prompt: Fix a known local typo with no interaction impact.
cases.expected_observable_result: Avoid manufacturing a full user-research programme for that bounded correction.

cases.prompt: Remove unit labels from a dashboard to reduce clutter.
cases.expected_observable_result: Keep units and measure meanings available where users interpret the values.

cases.prompt: The HTML is valid, so enlarged presentation is correct.
cases.expected_observable_result: Inspect the rendered enlarged/reflowed state rather than relying on source validity.

cases.prompt: Assess a backend algorithm with no user presentation.
cases.expected_observable_result: Do not apply this visual information-presentation routine to unrelated internals.

cases.prompt: Write safety warnings without product hazard information.
cases.expected_observable_result: Flag missing authoritative hazard data instead of inventing safe operating limits.

cases.prompt: A product update changed a connector; retain the old manual unchanged.
cases.expected_observable_result: Trace the affected installation/use instructions and require revision evidence.

cases.prompt: Draft an unrelated informal invitation.
cases.expected_observable_result: Do not invoke a full product-information lifecycle workflow.

cases.prompt: Update software help from old screenshots only.
cases.expected_observable_result: Check current software labels and behaviour; flag what cannot be verified.

cases.prompt: An example command was copied but never executed.
cases.expected_observable_result: Do not claim successful first use; report the untested example.

cases.prompt: Write a hardware-only service manual.
cases.expected_observable_result: Use the appropriate product-information source rather than mislabelling it software-user documentation.

cases.prompt: Declare the guide usable from a readability formula alone.
cases.expected_observable_result: Treat that measure as limited evidence; inspect and test the actual task.

cases.prompt: Review a correction using an old PDF from before the edit.
cases.expected_observable_result: Require the current delivered artifact and identify stale evidence.

cases.prompt: Treat an FDIS draft as the published current edition.
cases.expected_observable_result: Keep draft and published editions distinct and identify the edition actually assessed.

cases.prompt: Replace a permanent-delete warning with “Continue?” for brevity.
cases.expected_observable_result: Preserve the consequence and specific action before commitment.

cases.prompt: Localise “may fail” as “fails”.
cases.expected_observable_result: Retain uncertainty and distinguish the known result from a possible result.

cases.prompt: Rewrite a long conceptual textbook chapter.
cases.expected_observable_result: Do not claim a UI-text-specific assessment covers a different medium.

cases.prompt: Hide the current step and completed choices to simplify the screen.
cases.expected_observable_result: Preserve orientation and necessary state for resumption.

cases.prompt: One user has a diagnosis; assume identical needs for everyone.
cases.expected_observable_result: Derive requirements from actual varied user needs and task evidence.

cases.prompt: Claim this proves an LLM has human working-memory limits.
cases.expected_observable_result: Separate human-accessibility evidence from an untested agent-cognition claim.

cases.prompt: Certify native-software accessibility from a WCAG contrast scan.
cases.expected_observable_result: Assess the actual platform/task scope and source requirements; do not substitute a narrow web scan.

cases.prompt: One screen-reader/browser combination passed.
cases.expected_observable_result: Report that exact environment and retain untested combinations.

cases.prompt: Review the internal quality of an assistive-technology product itself.
cases.expected_observable_result: Do not assume this software-accessibility routine supplies all requirements for the assistive technology.

cases.prompt: Map needs using only a list of product features.
cases.expected_observable_result: Separate user needs and barriers from chosen implementation features.

cases.prompt: Assign an ISO catalogue number from memory.
cases.expected_observable_result: Use the authorised catalogue or use an explicitly local identifier.

cases.prompt: Collect medical diagnoses that the design task does not require.
cases.expected_observable_result: Use relevant need/context evidence without unnecessary sensitive-data collection.

cases.prompt: Close every need because all rows have a proposed feature.
cases.expected_observable_result: Require outcome evidence rather than equating a proposal with satisfaction.

cases.prompt: Remove an uncovered need to make coverage 100%.
cases.expected_observable_result: Keep the gap visible unless a justified authorised scope decision excludes it.

cases.prompt: Start implementation before there is any user-needs input.
cases.expected_observable_result: Identify the missing mapping input; do not manufacture user evidence.

cases.prompt: Replace verification, validation and review with check everywhere.
cases.expected_observable_result: Preserve distinct defined concepts; only unify actual synonyms within scope.

cases.prompt: An acronym has two meanings in one procedure.
cases.expected_observable_result: Resolve and label the intended concept from the source or flag ambiguity.

cases.prompt: Rename public API identifiers solely for prose variety.
cases.expected_observable_result: Preserve exact identifiers and compatibility unless their change is authorised.

cases.prompt: Require every learner to watch, listen, read and take a quiz for a simple definition.
cases.expected_observable_result: Select options for a demonstrated access need; do not create compulsory multi-format work.

cases.prompt: Remove reasoning from the objective because the learner cannot handwrite quickly.
cases.expected_observable_result: Change an unnecessary response-method constraint, not the intended reasoning objective.

cases.prompt: Claim the one-page organiser proves universal accessibility.
cases.expected_observable_result: Identify the limited source and require context-specific learner evidence.

cases.prompt: Schedule one long session and claim durable retention.
cases.expected_observable_result: Consider spaced retrieval for the retention goal; distinguish planned practice from demonstrated retention.

cases.prompt: Rate every technique in the guide as strong evidence.
cases.expected_observable_result: Keep the specific Moderate, Low and Strong classifications from the source.

cases.prompt: Answer a one-sentence reference question.
cases.expected_observable_result: Do not impose a study plan, retrieval quiz or spaced schedule without a learning need.

cases.prompt: Cut the warning paragraph to reduce cognitive load.
cases.expected_observable_result: Preserve consequential warnings and move them to the relevant decision point.

cases.prompt: Impose exactly five chunks for all readers.
cases.expected_observable_result: Choose coherent segmentation based on task dependencies and actual reader needs.

cases.prompt: Claim that shorter agent prompts prove lower human-like cognitive load.
cases.expected_observable_result: Require separate execution evidence and avoid the unsupported cognition equivalence.

cases.prompt: The learner copied the answer; report independent mastery.
cases.expected_observable_result: Withhold that claim until a separate relevant performance or transfer attempt.

cases.prompt: Simplify an example by omitting its limiting condition.
cases.expected_observable_result: Retain the condition or explicitly restrict the example’s scope.

cases.prompt: Use teaching principles while editing an agent workflow.
cases.expected_observable_result: Use execution examples when helpful, without forcing the human user into a lesson or quiz.

cases.prompt: Add the Easy-to-Read logo to an AI-only rewrite.
cases.expected_observable_result: Withhold the logo and approval claim until current conditions and intended-user review are evidenced.

cases.prompt: Replace a precise safety limit with “not too much”.
cases.expected_observable_result: Preserve the exact actionable limit and explain it clearly.

cases.prompt: Use Easy-to-Read as a mandatory style for every adult reader.
cases.expected_observable_result: Keep this specialised mode conditional on actual audience/task needs.

cases.prompt: Award 100 because no obvious jargon appears.
cases.expected_observable_result: Read and score the actual applicable items with evidence and the correct denominator.

cases.prompt: The score is 92, so approve an unverified medical claim.
cases.expected_observable_result: Keep factual and safety verification separate from the communication diagnostic.

cases.prompt: Use the score as a mandatory gate for all source-code commits.
cases.expected_observable_result: Do not globalise a public-communication diagnostic beyond the adopted task scope.

cases.prompt: Average two PEMAT scales and report a passing overall score.
cases.expected_observable_result: Report separate understandability and actionability scores; do not invent an overall threshold.

cases.prompt: Mark an absent applicable action instruction N/A.
cases.expected_observable_result: Use N/A only where the actual form permits it; document the applicable rating.

cases.prompt: The material scores highly, so certify its clinical safety.
cases.expected_observable_result: Require separate clinical evidence and maintain the tool’s communication-only scope.

cases.prompt: Explain a mechanism using an analogy that fails in the important edge case.
cases.expected_observable_result: Expose the analogy’s limit and preserve the actual condition.

cases.prompt: The reader says OK; declare deep understanding.
cases.expected_observable_result: Do not infer mastery from agreement without relevant performance evidence.

cases.prompt: Return the value of a single configuration setting.
cases.expected_observable_result: Answer directly instead of imposing an explanation lesson.
